Test Case Title: add two products to the cart
Preconditions: Browser open, user not logged in, empty cart.
Test Steps:
1. Open /products.
2. Hover the first product and click "Add to cart"; click "Continue Shopping".
3. Hover the second product and click "Add to cart"; click "View Cart".
Test Data: First two products of the catalogue.
Expected Result: Both products are in the cart with the correct price, quantity 1 and total equal to the price.

Test Case Title: product quantity from the detail page is kept in the cart
Preconditions: Browser open, user not logged in, empty cart.
Test Steps:
1. Open /product_details/1.
2. Set quantity to 4 and click "Add to cart".
3. Click "View Cart".
Expected Result: Cart shows quantity 4, price Rs. 500 and total Rs. 2000.

Test Case Title: remove a product from the cart
Preconditions: Browser open, user not logged in, empty cart.
Test Steps:
1. Add a product to the cart and open the cart.
2. Click the delete (X) button of the product.
Expected Result: The product is removed and "Cart is empty!" is shown.

Test Case Title: a fresh visitor has an empty cart
Preconditions: Browser open, user not logged in, empty cart.
Expected Result: "Cart is empty!" is shown and there are no cart lines.

Test Case Title: search products and verify the cart after login
Preconditions: A registered user exists (created through the API with a unique e-mail).
Test Steps:
1. Open /products, search "top" and add the first two results to the cart.
2. Open the cart and verify the products.
3. Log in with the registered user.
4. Open the cart again.
Expected Result: The products added before login are still in the cart after login.
